products.name: Ubuntu 26 Runner Check
products.deployment_verified: 2026-10-10 (v1.0.0): deploy-pages run 38025447316 succeeded; live Playwright checks passed (sample, invalid/empty input, bad repo, 404 repo, live public-repo fetch of curl/curl 15 workflows, file upload, pinned-copy download, canary download, Markdown copy, mobile 375px no overflow); all assets 200; tests/ excluded from site (404); 23/23 unit tests; 129 real workflows from 12 popular repos analysed with no remaining false 'Breaks' findings.
products.problem: GitHub moves ubuntu-latest to Ubuntu 26.04 between Oct 19 and Nov 19, 2026 (runner-images #14748). The announcement lists version bumps but not removed tools (Java 8, Clang 16-18, GCC 12, Miniconda, Swift, Julia, Fastlane, Pulumi, global tsc/webpack/lerna...), and there is no official pre-migration check.
products.target_user: Developers and DevOps/platform engineers with GitHub Actions or Azure Pipelines jobs on ubuntu-latest
evidence: actions/runner-images#14748 (48 comments; a commenter asks which preinstalled programs are most likely to break, unanswered)
Ubuntu2404 vs Ubuntu2604 image READMEs and toolset JSON diff
Dev.to / Qiita / velog migration write-ups (Oct 2026) noting no official checker
Announcement table says Java 17 stays default while README/toolset say 25
existing_solutions: getreadystack actions-expiry-lint (dated runner/action/Node checks, no per-tool 26.04 analysis)
runner-drift CLI (diffs runner tool output, needs runs)
products.differentiation: Step-level detection of tools removed from the 26.04 image with line numbers, mitigation-aware (setup-* actions, npx, services, containers), plus pinned-copy and side-by-side canary workflow generation; works on public repos without a token; Azure Pipelines support.
products.monetization: none now; possible later: GitHub App/Action that comments on PRs before future image migrations (free for public repos).
products.social_promotion: drafted (launch/runner-26-check/posts.md), not published: X/Bluesky/Facebook/Mastodon not connected

changelog.change: initial release: repo/paste/upload input, runs-on resolution, removed-tool and version-change rules from official toolsets, macOS 14/22.04 label checks, Markdown checklist, pinned copy, canary workflow, Azure Pipelines
